assets.prompt:
Images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their hand-drawn ink lines, soft watercolor shading, quiet paper texture, restrained palette, perspective and level of detail. Image 3 shows the approved look of the brass-and-walnut device with seven colored cartridges, the braided cable with tiny points of warm light, and the plant; keep that look with a small robot instead of the ceramic head.
Brief:
Use case: stylized editorial website illustration.
Asset type: standalone transparent PNG still life for "Effective Agent", seven open-source skills that give a coding agent knowledge and judgment: a gentle metaphor for skills being loaded into an agent.
The robot: a small, friendly, vintage-style robot like a well-made old tin toy, about the height of a desk lamp, sitting or standing on a tabletop; rounded body and head of cream enamel with warm brass seams, rivets and joints, two simple round glass eyes with a calm, curious look, small antenna, no mouth or a very subtle one; endearing but dignified, not cartoonish, not menacing, not humanoid-realistic.
Style: hand-drawn blue-gray ink lines, soft watercolor washes, cream enamel, warm brass and walnut, restrained rusty-orange accents and a pale-blue watercolor haze behind the objects; calm, warm, lightly science-fiction.
The seven skills: seven small cartridges in muted colors (navy, teal, rusty orange, ochre, sage green, plum, slate blue).
Composition: landscape 4:3, objects grouped slightly off-center, three-quarter view on a tabletop like the references, modest transparent padding so nothing is clipped, soft contact shadows.
Background: genuine alpha transparency around the illustration with softly fading watercolor edges; solid objects stay fully opaque.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere; no people, no film characters, no screens, no green digital rain, no weapons; no border, frame, watermark or checkerboard baked into pixels.
Output: the highest native resolution the tool supports.
Scene: the robot sits on the table, facing left. A fine braided cable runs from a small brass port at the back of its head to a compact brass-and-walnut device beside it, with the seven colored cartridges plugged into the device. Tiny points of warm light travel along the cable toward the robot; its eyes have a soft warm glow, as if it is learning. A small leafy plant in a pale gray pot stands toward the back right.
